purpose: anonymised router fixtures for zendesk-bug-report-package shared-agent routing

cases.input: Create a bug package from this Zendesk ticket for engineering.
cases.expected_supporting_skill: zendesk-evidence-collector if the ticket evidence has not been assembled yet
cases.notes: The requested deliverable is a support-safe defect package.

cases.input: Customer says the dashboard is broken again. Can you package this as a bug?
cases.notes: The intent is bug packaging, but the package should mark not ready and request exact reproduction detail.

cases.input: Customer is blocked and angry during launch; package this for immediate intervention.
cases.expected_supporting_skill: zendesk-bug-report-package if defect evidence is available
cases.notes: Urgent cross-functional intervention and relationship risk dominate pure defect packaging.

cases.input: Is this a product bug or expected behaviour according to the Help Center docs?
cases.notes: Documentation grounding should resolve expected behaviour before defect packaging.

cases.input: Review this bug package before I send it to engineering.
cases.notes: An existing output needs QA rather than first-pass bug package creation.
